summary: Reconcile the 0.2.9 release, VM recovery guidance and implementation plans with the committed implementation and final disposable-lab evidence. API impact: none; this changes documentation only and describes existing contracts.

guide.reason: The VM guides now match failed-create reconciliation, separate automatic-start tasks and the refusal to remove a TPM; the release guide covers both final and prerelease version forms.

api.reason: API impact: none. The documented behavior already exists in the current VM create, VM update, VM power and release tooling contracts; no endpoint, command or schema changed.

roadmap.reason: The plans are reconciled with already-recorded acceptance evidence; no website roadmap milestone or built/outstanding item changes in this documentation-only correction.

state.reason: Documentation reconciliation creates no durable Controller or Core state.

verification.method: Compared the committed implementation, API reference, change records and retained QA reports; independently audited roadmap, guide/API, bug/QA and release documentation; then ran the documentation gate, its unit tests, repository privacy check, JSON parsing and diff checks.
